steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: Thank you so much, hanimefendi!

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: I still can't believe my lovely daughter would leave her old father like this. She won't even read my letters!

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: It's almost the day of the rainmaking ritual. I can't thank you enough for being willing to play the part of my daughter and help us complete it!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Don't mention it! I'm sure your daughter only left on a whim, and she'll come running back to her loving, wealthy father before you know it.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Incidentally, I'm not here for the reward or anything—I just couldn't bear to see such a kind father wasting away from sorrow.

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: Oh, you sweet, sweet girl!

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: I really hope you've had a good time staying at my palace these days. I must thank you again. Here, take the promised reward! And there will be more once the ritual is complete!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Oh, you're too kind! How could anyone hurt the feelings of a kind father like you?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Look at this bag of cash! Now that's what I'm talking about! And he's paying this much up front?! And I get to live in a palace?! I've hit the jackpot!)

spans.text: (Look at this bag of cash! Now that's what I'm talking about! And he's paying this much up front?!
I get to live in a palace?! I've hit the jackpot!)

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Please come with me, kind hanimefendi!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Sure, thanks!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Please, kind hanimefendi, no need to thank us! We are simply doing our duty.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Whisper) Why would the lord ameer's daughter run from such a lavish life in the palace, surrounded by jewels and servants?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Whisper) What kind of crazy person doesn't want the good life?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Whisper) Well, whatever, more for me then!
The soft and comfy palanquin takes a few turns and stops in front of a luxurious mansion.
The servants carry Rose Salt down from her seat, and the lord ameer gives the orders for the gates to be opened.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Wow...
Fire burns in the fireplace of the grand hall, the flames flickering to the breeze of the servants' movements.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: We can hold a ball here whenever you want.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: A ball...
Gentle music fills the room. Rose Salt takes off her shoes before stepping on the carpet with her bare feet, taking in its softness.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Such good manners... So adorable... Just like our dear princess.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: The lord ameer was crying just now when he told us to treat you as his own daughter.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: We prepared all sorts of clothing because we didn't know what you liked, hanimefendi.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Every season, the lord ameer commands us to procure new clothes. Linen, satin, silk, cotton... dresses, pants, robes, anything you want, we have it.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Perhaps this gem-set frock, this pearly silk skirt, or this long plumed dress? If you prefer something other than dresses, we also have many other selections—

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Oh, there's no need to choose, I like all of them!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Choose? Why would I choose when it can all be mine?!)

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Really? Oh, thank goodness... I can't believe you like everything I prepared!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: We have also prepared a simple dinner for you. I apologize for how humble it is, as we were not expecting you to arrive today.
Rose Salt has to gulp, lest her saliva overflow from her mouth at the myriad elaborate dishes laid out on the table.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Oh my god, that's soooo kind of you. I'm really not a picky eater, you know. There isn't a single thing here that I don't like!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Steak! Stew! Fruits! Fins! All mine!)
Night has fallen, and Rose Salt lies on a huge, soft feather bed, wearing a jewel-lined silk nightgown.
The white moonlight shines through the curtains, falling like water upon the marble floor.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: A good life... a life of luxury... it's mine at last!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: I'll never leave, no matter what!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: NEVER!
A few days have passed. Rose Salt is enjoying everything that the lord ameer's palace has to offer.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: *Yawn* That was a great night's sleep!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Mm... I wonder what I should eat today...

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Good morning, hanimefendi!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Would you like to have breakfast now? I've seen that you have a liking for meat, and have prepared it according to your tastes. Let me help you get washed, and then we will serve your meal.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Y-You guys were here all along?

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Of course, hanimefendi! In order to help you adjust to life here, we have been monitoring your every move twenty-four hours a day. We are absolutely confident that we can provide the best possible care!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Twenty-four hours a day?!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Of course! We are ever so grateful that you have agreed to help us with the ritual. It is hard to find people as kind-hearted as you! We'll make sure that your time here is as comfortable as it can possibly be.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: I... I want to get up...

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Please, don't move! I'll do it!
The servant stops Rose Salt from getting up, places a pillow under her, wipes her face clean with a cloth dipped in rose essence, and changes her clothes into a casual house dress.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: We can't possibly make our princess get up on her own!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Oh princess, you're so beautiful... According to our observations, you always wish to have breakfast as soon as you get up. Bring the table!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Huh? Wait...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Wow, this does look good...

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Please, don't move! I'll do it!
Another servant stops Rose Salt from moving her hand, before cutting a piece of steak and bringing it to her mouth.

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: We can't possibly make our princess cut her own meat! Here, open your mouth, hanimefendi, ahhhh—

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Ahhhh—

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: What is it, hanimefendi? Is it not to your taste?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (How old do they think I am, three? I don't need to be hand-fed!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Oh, no, not at all, I love it!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: But you hesitated! There must be a reason. Did I fail to adequately predict your tastes? Were you not satisfied with the steak's quality? Or was the seasoning not to your taste?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Does nobody here think it's weird to be hand-feeding me?)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Of course not! I'm super satisfied with the food. It's just... I want to eat on my own!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: B-But think of the toll on your delicate fingers! Ah, I know, I will wrap your utensils in silk ribbons, so that they will not harm your fine skin!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Here, I've wrapped them for you... are they too heavy? Do your wrists hurt? What about your fingers? Maybe I should feed you after all...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: No, not at all, there's no need, no problem at all...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Finshit! Just leave me alone!)

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: You must not exert yourself nor carry anything heavy! All you need to do is enjoy everything in perfect comfort!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: It already pains me so much to see you eating by your own hands!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Help!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Oh, not at all!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Being able to help you all is already more than enough for me. I wouldn't want to be a burden to such kind people!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: But please, let me eat on my own... That's what I'm used to...

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: I-I see... as you wish...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ...(Chews with a forced smile)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Please, stop giving me that doting look! I'm getting indigestion!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Alright, I'm done!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Hanimefendi! How are your hands?

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Were the dishes to your liking?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Absolutely! Thank you so much!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Now that I've eaten, I'd like to go for a walk, take a look around.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: You would like to go out? Of course! Where to? The garden is beautiful, and we have all sorts of adorable pets to keep you company. Allow me to—

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: No, no, I know, you're here to make me happy, right?

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Of course, hanimefendi!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Then do you know what would make me happiest?

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Let me explore the garden by myself! I'd be happiest if you're not on my tail!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Wh-What do you...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Like I said! I would be so very, very pleased if you didn't do that! So, please, absolutely do not follow me!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Finally, I can breathe! What is WRONG with those people? At least I've lost them, finally.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: So, I get to enjoy this entire garden all to myself? Is this how the wealthy live?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Ah... This rocking chair feels so good. They even have a pavilion with ice to keep you cool, and delicious fresh fruit... but... but...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Why do I feel like I'm being watched?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Don't see anyone... Must be my imagination.

steps.name: Servant in Bushes
steps.text: (Whisper) Success! She didn't see me.

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Excellent. Report if the hanimefendi wants anything! And don't you dare let her spot you!

steps.name: Servant in Bushes
steps.text: (Whisper) Roger!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Forget it. This is the perfect place for a nap...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Zzz... mm... Oh, the flowers are starting to making my nose itch... ah-choo!

steps.name: Servant in Bushes
steps.text: (Whisper) The hanimefendi just sneezed! Repeat, the hanimefendi just sneezed!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Roger! I'll send a handkerchief this instant!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Squad Two & Three, cut the flowers around her. Do not disturb her or be seen!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Achoo!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Did I just hear something...? A bee, maybe?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: This place is like heaven. There are butterflies, bees, fowlbeasts, and white clouds in the blue skies...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: And a drone...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: A drone?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: A drone... carrying a handkerchief?!
Before Rose Salt can figure out why there is a drone, she hears the sound of scissors snipping.
A hand reaches out of the bushes to catch a rose before it hits the ground, then promptly disappears into the foliage.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Wh-What's that sound?
Snip! Snip! Snip!
Rose Salt looks around, but sees nothing. Somehow, the flowers keep disappearing one after another, even though there is no one else around.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (How could someone be that fast?! I've been picking pockets for who knows how long, but I can't even catch a glimpse!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Not in this shrub, or this one! Who is it? What are they doing?)
Snip!
The last flower disappears from plain sight. Yet as far as she can tell, she is the only one in the garden.
Rose Salt can't help but clench the handkerchief tight in her hand, and realizes that there is a slip of paper inside.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: 'I am not your servant, hanimefendi! Nor am I by your side! Please, cover your nose with this handkerchief to keep the pollen out!'

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ...AHHHH!!!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: HELP—!!!

steps.name: Servant in Bushes
steps.text: (Whisper) Phew... mission accomplished! The hanimefendi didn't see any of us!

steps.name: Servant in Bushes
steps.text: (Whisper) Hey, what's going on? She just ran away screaming!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Oh no! We must not be doing a good enough job!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ¡Dios mío! What the finshit is going on? Have they been watching me from the shadows all this time?!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: They're loco! Should I just run away?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: But the lord ameer is paying so much. So, so much. Not to mention the completion bonus, and all the luxury... I-I don't want to leave!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Damn it, damn it!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Oh, there you are, hanimefendi!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: No! Leave me the hell alone!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Er, what I meant to say is... I've realized that you've been following me in secret, and I'm NOT happy about it!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: I'm going to take a bath now! Do NOT follow me this time!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: How could this be...? Was it not enough? She is unhappy because we haven't shown her enough love!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Quick, we must do something... To make the hanimefendi truly enjoy her life here and feel our gratitude!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: I'm really alone now? There's no one watching me?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Finshit. How long do I have to hide in here? Have they really left?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Damn it. I shouldn't let the private bath of the lord ameer's daughter go to waste! Fragrance oils, flower petals... if I'm here, I may as well enjoy it!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Fill up the tub... put in some oils and petals...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Why is there a big hole on the floor of the bathroom?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: A tunnel? Right in the middle of the princess's bathroom? And it wasn't sealed up?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Is there something down there?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: The tunnel is so long... it's even got lighting... What's going on here?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Something's written on the wall. 'They love me so much. I can't take it anymore!' 'I don't want people watching my every move!' 'I have no freedom! I want to run away! I've had enough of this life!'

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Were these left behind by the real daughter? I was wondering why she ran away from home... And now I know! I can't take it anymore either!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Hey, this tunnel leads outside!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Does this mean I can get out? Couldn't I just pretend to take bath all day and do what I want outside before coming back at night? That way, I could enjoy the good life and still get some me time!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Yeah... it's the perfect plan! This way!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: I'm almost at the exit! I'm getting outta here!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Just a little bit further... a little further, and I'll be free at last!
Oh my...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Whoa! Who's there?!
It seems like we've made a good decision about keeping this tunnel the princess dug herself. You really are just like her, right down to how you try to run away while taking a bath!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: AHHH! HELP—!!
Five days later

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: There you go, hanimefendi! Look how beautiful your skin has become now that you haven't had to lift a finger these past few days! Now, my heart can truly be at ease.

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: We've bathed you, powdered you, perfumed you, and put you in this beautiful dress. Now you're ready for the ritual!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: All you need to do is to transfer water from the golden bowl to the golden basin using a willow branch. The more water you flick in, the more successful the ritual!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Okay...

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Finally! The finshit things I do for money! Let's get this over with and I'm outta here!)

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: You look so beautiful today, hanimefendi! Let's go to the ritual now!
Rose Salt lifts the hems of her long dress and walks on the feather-paved streets with shoes of silk.
The citizens gaze upon her with expectant eyes, hoping for the ritual to be a success.

As she struggles to breathe under five or six layers of clothing, the choking scent of the powders and perfumes, and the weight of the complex braids that took two hours to tie, she makes up her mind.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Outside at last! It's now or never! I don't even care about that finshit completion bonus anymore!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Screw the ritual! I've got the money with me, so I'm making a run for it!)

steps.name: Excited Citizen
steps.text: Hanimefendi! Hanimefendi!

steps.name: Happy Citizen
steps.text: The ritual will go great with you!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (I'll smash the bowl, stir up the feathers as a distraction, and throw the dizzyleaf bundles on the torches... it's the perfect plan!)

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Don't worry, hanimefendi, I'll carry you on my back if you're tired!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: Is the golden bowl too heavy for you? I can carry it until we arrive.

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: Oh, sweet, sweet girl!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Arrgghh! I don't wanna see these people ever again!)

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: (Now!)
Rose Salt finds an opportunity and pulls her elaborate dress off!
In her mind, she had pictured herself escaping with the same agility she is accustomed to, disappearing in the blink of an eye before anyone realizes what happened.

In reality, she trips over her silk shoes and the feathers on the ground. As feathers fly, the golden bowl and dizzyleaf bundles fly uncontrollably in every direction, while she herself falls flat on the ground.

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ...Oh no.
To her surprise, she hears nothing but cheers around her.

steps.name: Excited Citizen
steps.text: Hanimefendi! It's a miracle! A miracle!

steps.name: Happy Citizen
steps.text: The golden bowl fell right into the basin! Not a single drop was spilled! It's a divine miracle! All hail the hanimefendi!

steps.name: Excited Citizen
steps.text: All hail the hanimefendi!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Wh-What?

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: My sweet girl! I can't believe it...

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: Not only did you agree to help me, you performed the ritual so spectacularly! Please, accept these bags of gems as a token of my gratitude!

steps.name: Doting Servant
steps.text: Oh, hanimefendi! The ritual has never been so successful! This is fantastic!

steps.name: Kindly Servant
steps.text: My eyes are filled with tears! Please, take my hand and I'll help you up! The palanquin is already here. We'll take you home and make dinner for you!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ...No! NO!!
Rose Salt grabs the gems from the lord ameer and runs away screaming, not slowing down until she is at least a few hundred meters away.

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: Oh, my girl, why do you run away?

steps.name: Lord Ameer
steps.text: The ritual was a great success! Come back next year! I'd love to have you back!

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: ABSOLUTELY NOT!
Two weeks later

steps.name: Operator A
steps.text: I heard there are a few new stories in the latest edition of Sargonian Fables. The best is 'The Lord Ameer and His Daughters.'

steps.name: Operator A
steps.text: It's about how both daughters of a lord ameer ran away from home, preferring the hard life outside.

steps.name: Operator A
steps.text: Crazy, isn't it? Why would anyone just throw away a good life like that?

steps.name: Operator B
steps.text: Absolutely. All those gems, gardens, clothes, the food... Who would run away from their own happiness?

steps.name: Operator B
steps.text: It just doesn't make sense, right, Rose Salt?

steps.name: Rose Salt
steps.text: Uh, yeah... whatever you say...
